title: terrain.terrain_dirty_region_batch
description: Per-tick coalesced dirty-region batch. Emitted ONCE per tick when ANY chunks were touched by carves. Holds ALL source event ids that contributed to the batch (deduplicated, in deterministic insertion order), the in/out rect counts, and the M22-forward-compat `unupdated_areas` field (rects merged below the ≤25-rect budget per terrain-material-slice-a). M3 re-open 2026-05-13.

source_event_ids.description: Every carve event id that contributed a dirty rect to this batch, deduplicated in insertion order. Replay viewers walk this list for the full causal fan-in.

in_rects.description: Pre-coalesce rect count (integer) — the number of (cx,cy)-keyed dirty entries pushed by carves this tick. Spec older versions allowed an array of rect objects; the integer form is canonical from M3 re-open onward.

out_rects.description: Post-coalesce rect list (≤25 entries per terrain-material-slice-a budget). Each rect is {cx, cy, min:[x,y], max:[x,y]} in pixel coordinates.

unupdated_areas.description: M22-forward-compat: count of rects merged into another rect during coalescing (i.e. `rects_in - rects_out`). When this is sustained > 0 across many ticks the engine emits `terrain.forced_refresh_requested` so the pathfinder can rebuild its cost grid.
